[[javascript]] let urlPromise = stack_js.get_content('[[quid id="img-data"/]]'); urlPromise.then(function(base64Data) { if (!base64Data) { stack_js.display_error("Base64 introuvable."); return; } var img = new Image(); img.onload = function() { // Nouvelle taille maximale var maxW = 300; // Calcul du ratio pour garder les proportions parfaites var ratio = Math.min(1, maxW / img.naturalWidth); var w = Math.floor(img.naturalWidth * ratio); var h = Math.floor(img.naturalHeight * ratio); function processChannel(channelIndex, targetId) { var canvas = document.createElement('canvas'); canvas.width = w; canvas.height = h; var ctx = canvas.getContext('2d'); ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h); var imageData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, w, h); var data = imageData.data; for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) { if (channelIndex !== 0) data[i] = 0; if (channelIndex !== 1) data[i+1] = 0; if (channelIndex !== 2) data[i+2] = 0; } ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0); var dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/png'); var imgTag = ''; stack_js.switch_content(targetId, imgTag); } processChannel(0, '[[quid id="target-r"/]]'); processChannel(1, '[[quid id="target-g"/]]'); processChannel(2, '[[quid id="target-b"/]]'); }; img.src = "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64Data.trim(); }); [[/javascript]]
